searchText: Hi, I have a question about the transaction fee after merging eth1 and eth2. Does only block proposer receive the fee or it split to all online/attesting validators? In the period both POS and POW running, is miner or validator reward the transaction fee? the block producer always gets the value from the txs they choose to include pre-merge, this is to the miners post, merge this is to the validator even during the merge itself, there will be a single chain formed connecting pow to pos. The block producer (miner or validator) for each block on that chain is the one that gets the tx fee value consensus-layer call 😅 in 55 minutes https://github.com/ethereum/eth2.0-pm/issues/217 Meeting in the same place as usual? I'm a bit early, but server is more dead than I would expect. Well, same place as "I have in my calendar which may be out of date"? Quick notes from the call: https://hackmd.io/@benjaminion/B1wRBDWdd
